To navigate this complex landscape, GlobeGuard must immediately: 1. Prioritize strengthening supply chain resilience and energy independence through aggressive diversification of essential resources and implementation of robust backup solutions. 2. Rebalance financial portfolios towards defensive assets, prudently navigating tech market volatility while assessing broader economic and geopolitical pressures. 3.
